brief: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site with menu, hours, location and pre-order for pickup. We want a big photo gallery of the cafe AND a detailed story section about each of our three coffee farms. Keep costs low.
outcome: Out of budget: 0 of 58 units left, less than the cheapest rate-card part (5), so no new workflow can be funded.

raises.why: the Requester chose option 2: Raise the budget by 23 and build the phone fix plus the three farm stories. The photo gallery is dropped from this site.

asked: Brew Lab's site now has the menu, hours, location and pickup pre-order (30 of 35 budget spent). Still missing: the photo gallery with lightbox (about 20), the three farm stories (about 20), and a fix for the page overflowing on a 360px phone (about 8). Only 5 budget remains. Which do you want?

conflicts.subject: what to fund in cycle 1
conflicts.outcome: Adaptation accepted Priority's COUNTER: Page shell, hours and location (15), Menu and pickup pre-order form (15) goes to the validator.

done_when.criterion: The site is a single HTML file with inline CSS and JS and needs no build step.
The page names Brew Lab and Indiranagar, Bengaluru, and has navigation links that jump to each section.
A menu section lists items grouped by category, with unknown prices marked as placeholders.
An hours section lists all seven days, marked as placeholder where unknown.
A location section shows the address (placeholder if unknown) and an embedded map or map link for Indiranagar, Bengaluru.
A pre-order for pickup form lets the visitor choose menu items and quantities, enter name, phone and pickup time, see a running total, and submit to a marked placeholder destination.
A photo gallery section has at least 12 image slots in a responsive grid with a lightbox, alt text on every image, and placeholder images clearly marked.
Three separate farm story sections each have a name, location, multi-paragraph story and key details (such as altitude, variety, process), all marked as placeholders where unknown.
The file has a viewport meta tag and responsive CSS so it works on a phone-width screen.
Every placeholder in the file is visibly marked as a placeholder.
